title: Cartan--Eilenberg presentation of termwise etale hypercohomology
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $K^\bullet$ a bounded-below complex of abelian sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. A termwise hypercohomology presentation is the following collection of the witnesses in [thm-sp-if-e1], using the double-complex total and its filtration [def-sp-double-complex-total], with the convention for applying a functor and extending the resolution index of [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation]. It consists of a bicomplex $I^{s,r}$ ($s\in\mathbb Z$, $r\in\mathbb N$), an augmentation $a:K\to I$ from $K$ in resolution degree zero, a lower bound in $s$, injective terms, quasi-isomorphic augmented rows, injective horizontal cycles, boundaries and cohomology, and quasi-isomorphic augmentations of those three complexes. It includes a filtration $L$ by subcomplexes of $T=\operatorname{Tot}(\Gamma(X,I))$ whose degreewise steps are the second-degree filtration, a page-zero cohomological spectral sequence $E$ [def-sp-spectral-sequence], identifications of $E_0^{s,r}$ with $(\operatorname{gr}^sL)^{s+r}$ respecting the differential, and for every $t\geq1$ identifications of $E_t^{s,r}$ with the cycle/boundary subquotients of $L$. It includes the signed identifications $E_1^{s,p}\cong R^p\Gamma(X,K^s)$ with $d_1$ induced by $d_K$, identifications $R^p\Gamma(X,K^s)\cong H^p(X,K^s)$ respecting $d_K$, and vanishing for negative resolution degree. Finally it includes a K-injective resolution $\rho:K\to J$ [def-sp-kinjective-bridge], the natural augmentation $K\to\operatorname{Tot}I$ into resolution-degree-zero summands, a comparison $\operatorname{Tot}I\to J$ over $K$ up to homotopy, its global-sections map $w:T\to\Gamma(X,J)$ specified on each diagonal summand, and the isomorphism $c_n:H^n(T)\cong H^n(X,K)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] induced by $H^n(w)$ and the canonical resolution comparison of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. The abutment filtration $H_n$ [def-sp-filtration] is finite and has steps $H_n^s=(c_n)_*\operatorname{im}(H^n(L^s)\to H^n(T))$. Its intrinsic spectral sequence is the restriction of $E$ to pages $t\geq1$, with $E_1^{s,p}\cong H^p(X,K^s)$.
